name: release-reconcile
title: Release reconciliation
description: Read-only first-step release audit: compares tracker tickets and their target versions with the exact commits, merge requests and branches of your repositories, and flags version-without-code, code-without-version, source-only and partial deliveries, ancestry versus tree drift, reverts, unticketed and ambiguous commits. Evidence is collected by Octipus (repos:collect); unknown stays unknown.

profile_save.description: Save a reusable release-audit profile for you in this workspace

profile_delete.description: Delete one of your saved profiles

collector_options.description: List your environments, approved folders and connections for evidence collection

audit_start.description: Start a read-only release audit in the background (fetches audit refs only, reads Git history and tracker data)

audit_status.description: Read an audit run and, once done, its reconciliation report

audit_cancel.description: Cancel one of your running audits

setup_check.description: Check setup readiness without changing the connected services

profile_resources.description: Browse only the repositories and refs in the approved environment and folder

settings.label: Approved repository folders
settings.help: Absolute folders, one per line or comma-separated. A repository must also lie inside the user's execution environment folders.

settings.label: Approved connections
settings.help: Connection ids (Git fetch, issue tracker, forge), comma-separated. Each must also be available to the user.

settings.label: Evidence protection level
settings.help: Classification of collected evidence (1–4). This custom page supports Level 1 only; higher-level results are withheld.
